compressPdf.description: Reduce PDF file size while maintaining quality using Ghostscript
compressPdf.errorReadingPdf: Failed to read PDF file. Please make sure it is a valid PDF.
compressPdf.highCompressionDescription: Maximum file size reduction with some quality loss
compressPdf.longDescription: Compress PDF files securely in your browser using Ghostscript. Your files never leave your device, ensuring complete privacy while reducing file sizes for email sharing, uploading to websites, or saving storage space. Powered by WebAssembly technology.
compressPdf.lowCompressionDescription: Slightly reduce file size with minimal quality loss
compressPdf.mediumCompressionDescription: Balance between file size and quality
compressPdf.shortDescription: Compress PDF files securely in your browser
compressPdf.title: Compress PDF

convertToPdf.description: Convert various image formats (PNG, GIF, JPG, WEBP, HEIC, HEIF) to PDF, with options to scale the image and choose page orientation.
convertToPdf.shortDescription: Convert images to PDF with scale and orientation control
convertToPdf.title: Images to PDF

editor.description: Advanced PDF editor with annotation, form-fill, highlight, and export capabilities. Edit your PDFs directly in the browser with professional-grade tools including text insertion, drawing, highlighting, signing and form filling.
editor.shortDescription: Edit PDFs with advanced annotation, signing and editing tools
editor.title: PDF Editor

extractImagesFromPdf.description: Extract all embedded images from your PDF file in their original quality.
extractImagesFromPdf.longDescription: Upload a PDF document to automatically extract all embedded images. The tool preserves the original image quality and supports common formats such as JPG, PNG, and more. Ideal for recovering illustrations, photos, scanned pages, or assets from PDF documents.
extractImagesFromPdf.shortDescription: Extract images from a PDF file.
extractImagesFromPdf.title: Extract Images from PDF

toolInfo.description: This tool allows you to merge multiple PDF files into a single document. To use the tool, simply upload the PDF files you want to merge. The tool will then combine all pages from the input files into a single PDF document.
toolInfo.title: How to Use the Merge PDF Tool?

mergePdf.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document.
mergePdf.shortDescription: Merge multiple PDF files into a single document
mergePdf.sortByFileNameDescription: Sort PDFs alphabetically by file name
mergePdf.sortByUploadOrderDescription: Keep PDFs in the order they were uploaded
mergePdf.title: Merge PDF

toolInfo.description: This tool allows you to combine multiple PDF files into a single document. You can choose how to sort the PDFs and the tool will merge them in the specified order.
toolInfo.title: Merge PDF Files

pdfToEpub.description: Transform PDF documents into EPUB files for better e-reader compatibility.
pdfToEpub.shortDescription: Convert PDF files to EPUB format
pdfToEpub.title: PDF to EPUB

pdfToPng.description: Transform PDF documents into PNG panels.
pdfToPng.longDescription: Upload a PDF and convert each page into a high-quality PNG image directly in your browser. This tool is ideal for extracting visual content or sharing individual pages. No data is uploaded — everything runs locally.
pdfToPng.title: PDF to PNG

protectPdf.description: Add password protection to your PDF files securely in your browser
protectPdf.title: Protect PDF

rotatePdf.description: Rotate pages in a PDF document.
rotatePdf.longDescription: Change the orientation of PDF pages by rotating them 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Useful for fixing incorrectly scanned documents or preparing PDFs for printing.
rotatePdf.pageRangesDescription: Enter page numbers or ranges separated by commas (e.g., 1,3,5-7)
rotatePdf.shortDescription: Rotate pages in a PDF document
rotatePdf.title: Rotate PDF

toolInfo.description: This tool allows you to rotate pages in a PDF document. You can rotate all pages or specify individual pages to rotate. Choose a rotation angle: 90° Clockwise, 180° (Upside down), or 270° (90° Counter-clockwise). To rotate specific pages, uncheck "Apply to all pages" and enter page numbers or ranges separated by commas (e.g., 1,3,5-7).
toolInfo.title: How to Use the Rotate PDF Tool

splitPdf.description: Extract specific pages from a PDF document.
splitPdf.pageRangesDescription: Enter page numbers or ranges separated by commas (e.g., 1,3,5-7)
splitPdf.shortDescription: Extract specific pages from a PDF file
splitPdf.title: Split PDF

toolInfo.description: This tool allows you to extract specific pages from a PDF document. You can specify individual pages or ranges of pages to extract.
toolInfo.title: Split PDF

benitoOrganize.title: Organize PDF
benitoOrganize.description: Reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate and extract pages, or add blank pages, with page previews.
benitoOrganize.shortDescription: Reorder, rotate, delete and extract pages

benitoPageNumbers.title: Page numbers, header and footer
benitoPageNumbers.description: Add page numbers, a header or a footer to every page: position, format ("Page 1 of 10"), size and first page.
benitoPageNumbers.shortDescription: Add page numbers and header/footer text

benitoCrop.title: Crop PDF margins
benitoCrop.description: Trim the margins of the pages, with a live preview.
benitoCrop.shortDescription: Trim the margins of PDF pages

benitoSign.title: Sign PDF
benitoSign.description: Draw your signature with your finger, type it or use a picture, then place it on the pages you want.
benitoSign.shortDescription: Sign a PDF by drawing or typing your signature

benitoForms.title: Fill PDF form
benitoForms.description: Fill in the fields of a PDF form (text, checkboxes, menus) and optionally lock them.

benitoWatermark.title: Watermark and stamps
benitoWatermark.description: Add a text watermark or a stamp ("COPY", "APPROVED", date…) to the pages, with size, color, opacity and position.
benitoWatermark.shortDescription: Add watermarks or stamps to a PDF

benitoToImages.title: PDF to images
benitoToImages.description: Turn every page into a JPG, PNG or WebP picture, choosing the quality (DPI).
benitoToImages.shortDescription: Convert PDF pages to JPG, PNG or WebP

benitoToText.title: PDF to text
benitoToText.description: Extract all the text of a PDF as a .txt file.
benitoToText.shortDescription: Extract the text of a PDF

benitoScan.title: Scan to PDF
benitoScan.description: Turn photos of documents into a clean PDF like a scanner: black and white or grayscale, more contrast, A4 pages.
benitoScan.shortDescription: Turn photos of documents into a scanned-looking PDF

benitoOcr.title: OCR PDF
benitoOcr.description: Recognise the text in scanned PDFs: get a searchable PDF (you can select and copy the text) and the plain text.
benitoOcr.shortDescription: Make scanned PDFs searchable and copyable

benitoUnlock.title: Unlock PDF
benitoUnlock.description: Remove the password and the restrictions (print, copy) from a PDF you have the password for.
benitoUnlock.shortDescription: Remove password and restrictions from a PDF

benitoMetadata.title: Remove PDF metadata
benitoMetadata.description: Delete author, title, software, dates and other hidden information from a PDF.
benitoMetadata.shortDescription: Delete hidden information from a PDF

benitoRedact.title: Redact PDF
benitoRedact.description: Cover text and areas with black boxes for good: the marked pages are converted to images, so the hidden content cannot be recovered.
benitoRedact.shortDescription: Black out sensitive parts of a PDF permanently

benitoFlatten.title: Flatten PDF
benitoFlatten.description: Make form fields and annotations part of the page, so they cannot be changed anymore.
benitoFlatten.shortDescription: Lock forms and annotations into the page

benitoGrayscale.title: PDF to grayscale
benitoGrayscale.description: Convert a color PDF to grayscale, for printing or to save ink.
benitoGrayscale.shortDescription: Convert a PDF to black and white

benitoRepair.title: Repair PDF
benitoRepair.description: Try to fix damaged PDFs that do not open or show errors.
